turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Happy Friday, Marcus! How's your morning starting out in Portland?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Morning! It's going well. Grace and I got up early, and I grabbed a toasted bagel for breakfast to kick off the day.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Toasted bagels are always a great start. Did you manage to squeeze in a workout as well, or are you keeping things relaxed today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually headed out and did some gym weights earlier. It felt good to get a solid lift in before the heat of the day.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Outstanding! Getting those gym weights in early is a great feeling. Now that school is out for the summer, are you completely free from your chemistry teaching duties, or are you still prepping for next year?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Well, officially I'm off, but I've been doing a little light reading on some new chemistry lab ideas. I can't completely turn off the teacher brain, I guess!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That dedication is wonderful, and I'm sure your students will appreciate the fresh lab ideas come fall. Have you had any time for tennis lately, or are you saving that for the weekend?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm hoping to get on the court with Grace tomorrow morning if we can find an open spot. The local courts have been pretty packed lately.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Fingers crossed you get a court! If not, do you have any woodworking projects lined up in the garage to keep you busy?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I do! I'm planning to spend a couple of hours this afternoon working on a small cedar jewelry box. It's nice to just focus on the wood and clear my head.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a beautiful project to work on. Cedar is such a satisfying wood to use, too. I hope you enjoy your time in the workshop today!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I appreciate it. I'm going to head out there now while the light is still good.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Have a wonderful afternoon, Marcus. Let me know if you need anything else later!
